reviewItem.question: Does "RSA certificates with keys of length 3072 or 4096 will now use SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively as hash algorithms" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=rsa-certificate-signature-hash (behavior-changed)?

change.after: "SHA-384 for 3072-bit RSA keys, SHA-512 for 4096-bit RSA keys"

proposed.statement: RSA certificates with 3072- or 4096-bit keys are now signed with SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively, which may cause errors with peers that don't support these hashes as keys rotate.
